diagnosis.classification: Local HTTP media capability limitation, with misleading position confirmation in the UI.
diagnosis.observed: The media engine advertises seekable [0,0]. Range requests receive 200 with no Accept-Ranges or Content-Range. The metadata handler and Break/Return handlers request a position, but Edge clamps it to zero. No media error or page exception occurs.
repair_options: Implement real single-byte-range GET/HEAD support with correct 206, Content-Range, Content-Length, and 416 responses. Verify seeking before claiming a selected position.
Alternatively use fixed excerpt files for review and disable position controls when the media range does not support the requested position.
diagnosis.limit: The native file path was not exercised by this diagnostic. The observations use the current normal Node server.
